scope: Correct the English abstract move-recognition page without changing the Chinese abstract move-recognition page or other tool pages.
changes: Replaced the English capability-area selectors that reused Chinese CSS classes with English-only class names, preventing English page styles from changing Chinese page content.
Explicitly hides Chinese-only persistent panels while the English abstract move-recognition page is active, eliminating duplicated capability and task-status sections.
Kept the Chinese abstract move-recognition page at its V6.59/V6.60 visual state, with one capability panel and one workflow/status area.

Matched the English request-parameter note cards (input constraints, common exceptions, prototype note) to the exact local typography and spacing used by the Chinese page: 11px body text, 12px headings, 11px/12px padding, 9px radius, 10px grid gap, and 12px top margin.
Preserved the English validation, task execution, structured result, copy, and JSON download behavior introduced in V6.61.

checks: English page: English capability panel visible and Chinese capability panel hidden.
Chinese page: Chinese capability panel visible and English capability panel hidden.
English and Chinese request-parameter note cards have matching computed font size, line height, padding, and border radius.
No page errors were observed during Chromium switching tests.
